tools.name: check_in_patient_and_log_arrival
tools.description: Looks up an appointment, and if it is scheduled for today, marks the patient as checked in and records the arrival time. Returns the appointment details, the updated status and the number of patients still waiting ahead.

params.name: appointment_id
params.description: ID of the appointment to check in

params.name: copay_collected
params.description: Whether the front desk collected the copay at arrival

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "clinic.db"


@tool
def check_in_patient_and_log_arrival(appointment_id: int, copay_collected: bool = False) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    result = {"appointment_id": appointment_id, "ok": False}
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT a.id, a.patient_id, a.provider_id, a.start_time, a.status, "
            "p.first_name, p.last_name "
            "FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id "
            "WHERE a.id = ?",
            (appointment_id,),
        )
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            result["error"] = "appointment not found"
            return result

        now = datetime.now()
        start = datetime.fromisoformat(row["start_time"])
        if start.date() != now.date():
            result["error"] = "appointment is not scheduled for today"
            result["scheduled_for"] = row["start_time"]
            return result
        if row["status"] != "scheduled":
            result["error"] = "cannot check in from status " + row["status"]
            return result

        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE appointments SET status = 'checked_in', arrived_at = ?, copay_collected = ? "
            "WHERE id = ?",
            (now.isoformat(timespec="seconds"), int(copay_collected), appointment_id),
        )
        conn.commit()

        cur.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE provider_id = ? AND status = 'checked_in' "
            "AND start_time < ? AND id != ?",
            (row["provider_id"], row["start_time"], appointment_id),
        )
        ahead = cur.fetchone()[0]

        result.update(
            {
                "ok": True,
                "patient": row["first_name"] + " " + row["last_name"],
                "provider_id": row["provider_id"],
                "start_time": row["start_time"],
                "status": "checked_in",
                "arrived_at": now.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "copay_collected": copay_collected,
                "patients_ahead": ahead,
            }
        )
        return result
    finally:
        conn.close()
